# Nam

> Personal notes and writing.

This is Nam's Markdown blog. There is no CMS and no write API. Pages are
static HTML built with Material for MkDocs. The source is Markdown in
https://github.com/namndinh/blog/. To add or fix a page, clone the repo
and open a pull request.

## Writing

- [Writing](https://namdinh.xyz/writing/): post index
- [The "AI agent as a user" checklist](https://namdinh.xyz/writing/2026/09/06/the-human-agent-ready-checklist/): seven places the second user hits a wall
- [How this blog works](https://namdinh.xyz/writing/2026/09/06/how-this-blog-works/): how to clone the repo and contribute
- [RSS of new posts](https://namdinh.xyz/feed_rss_created.xml)
- [RSS of updated posts](https://namdinh.xyz/feed_rss_updated.xml)

## For agents

- [Search index](https://namdinh.xyz/search/search_index.json): JSON documents for full-text search
- [Agent manifest](https://namdinh.xyz/api/agent-manifest.json): feeds, search index, no MCP
- [Sitemap](https://namdinh.xyz/sitemap.xml)
- [Source](https://github.com/namndinh/blog/)

This site is read-only. There is no login, checkout, or MCP server. Fetch
pages and the search index over HTTPS. To publish, open a GitHub pull request.
